accepted.FIXED_APPLIED: A nonzero fixed rule result was booked.
accepted.PERCENTAGE_APPLIED: A nonzero exact percentage result was rounded once and booked.
accepted.ZERO_ADJUSTMENT: The permanent claim and zero revision were accepted without money actions.
accepted.CORRECTION_REPLACED: An expected-current correction appended any exact inverse and a nonzero replacement.
accepted.CORRECTION_ZERO: An expected-current correction appended any exact inverse and a zero live revision.

duplicate.DUPLICATE_IDENTITY: Return the exact original receipt for this accepted normalized command; no canonical append.
duplicate.DUPLICATE_CLAIM: Return the first claim receipt for the same original semantic facts under a new delivery label; no canonical append.

conflict.IDENTITY_CONFLICT: Existing scoped source/delivery ID has different canonical ingress.
conflict.CLAIM_CONFLICT: The permanent target/agreement/book/family slot already has different original facts; use an explicit correction.
conflict.STALE_CLAIM_REVISION: Correction does not name the current immutable revision ID.
conflict.ALREADY_REVERSED: A stored live action already has an inverse.

rejected.SOURCE_AUTHORITY: Current authenticated principal lacks permission for the designated source, family, book or correction.
rejected.ASSENT_REQUIRED: The exact payer/agreement requires retained valid assent evidence.
rejected.SUPPLIER_AUTHORITY: Supplier economics require separately retained authorization and explicit supplier correction authority.
rejected.PAYER_DELEGATION: Bearer differs from payer without retained scoped delegation.
rejected.EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Retained evidence is missing or cannot be resolved locally.
rejected.OUTCOME_CODE: Outcome code is absent from the original pinned policy.
rejected.TARGET_NOT_FINAL: Target is provisional, reversed or otherwise ineligible for a frozen basis.
rejected.OUTCOME_WINDOW: Occurrence is outside the pinned half-open window.
rejected.REPORT_TOO_LATE: Original report receipt is at or beyond report_before.
rejected.CORRECTION_TOO_LATE: Correction time or report receipt is at or beyond correct_before.
rejected.CLOCK_ORDER: Occurrence/correction, receipt and acceptance times violate the retained ordering rules.
rejected.AGGREGATE_LIMIT: Gross live premium or discount would exceed its independent pinned aggregate maximum.
rejected.LIMIT_TERMS_MISMATCH: Families for the target/agreement/book disagree on aggregate maxima.
rejected.CAP_OUTCOME_INCOMPATIBLE: A target participates in a capped stage; this profile forbids outcome composition even for zero or nonbinding cap cases.
rejected.PIN_CHANGED: A correction attempts to change its original basis or policy snapshot.
rejected.MONEY_UNIT: Referenced currency or scale is inconsistent.
rejected.INPUT_LIMIT: A numeric, byte, nesting, cardinality, precision or evidence bound is exceeded.
rejected.INVALID_CANONICAL_RECORD: Strict JSON, closed schema, structured identity, hash, ordering, reference, dependency, manifest or exact inverse verification failed.

notes: These are candidate outcome-contract codes, not changes to frozen v1 codes or HTTP mappings.
Rejected and conflict results append no accepted canonical rows, consume no claim identity and produce no accepted receipt.
Late reporting does not assert that real-world debt vanished; external authority review is outside this candidate.
Audit assertion labels are diagnostic invariants; unlisted internal labels map to INVALID_CANONICAL_RECORD rather than becoming new public codes.
